questions.questionText: What is radioactive decay? #465

questions.explanation: Radioactive decay is the spontaneous process by which an unstable atomic nucleus loses energy by emitting ionising radiation (alpha particles, beta particles, or gamma rays). It is a random process at the level of single atoms.

questions.questionText: What is the function of the split-ring commutator in a DC motor? #478

options.text: A DC motor uses a battery in a closed loop without a commutator

questions.explanation: A DC motor has a coil in a magnetic field. The split-ring commutator reverses the current direction every half-turn so that the force on the coil always acts in the same rotational direction, producing continuous rotation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly describes the image formed by a plane mirror? #479

options.label: A
options.text: Image distance = object distance (both behind the mirror); image is virtual and laterally inverted

options.text: Image distance = half object distance; image is real and inverted

options.label: C
options.text: Image distance = object distance; image is real and laterally inverted

options.label: D
options.text: Image distance = double object distance; image is real and same size

questions.explanation: A plane mirror produces a virtual image at the same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front. The image is the same size as the object and laterally inverted (left-right reversed).

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly describes Newton's Third Law? #492
